result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout problem with horizontally scrollable content that's partially cut off without clear indication, a major content issue with a duplicate restaurant listing, and a major styling issue with truncated restaurant name text.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows a third restaurant card (Smash Bros Bu) that is partially cut off on the right edge, indicating horizontal scrollable content without any visual indicator (carousel dots, arrows, or other UI cues) to inform users they can scroll
issues.suggestion: Add carousel indicators (dots or arrows) to clearly show that the section is horizontally scrollable, or ensure cards are fully visible within the viewport

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Pokéé' restaurant appears twice consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' section with identical information (15-25 min, €0.90 delivery), which appears to be a duplicate listing
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry and display unique restaurants, or if intentional, clarify why the same restaurant appears twice

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is truncated and appears incomplete, likely should read 'Smash Bros Burger' or similar
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text truncation logic or container width to display the full restaurant name, or use ellipsis (...) if space is limited
